# Trace Press

> Browser-based generator for Amazon KDP handwriting and letter tracing
> workbooks: an A–Z tracing interior in print (numbered start dots and
> stroke-order arrows on every letter) or joined cursive, with optional
> pre-writing lines, shapes, numbers 0–9, up to 52 practice words, a "This
> book belongs to" page and a "Well done!" page, plus the full-wrap cover
> (with optional back-cover text), a listing description and seven KDP
> keyword phrases,
> laid out to KDP's trim, bleed, margin and 0.75pt line rules. Six trims,
> four line sizes (1", 0.75", 0.6", 0.45"). Runs in the browser with no
> account. Free to use; free books carry one footer line and a cover
> marked PREVIEW, and $19 once removes both. Not affiliated with Amazon;
> KDP is a trademark of Amazon.com, Inc.

## Tools for KDP sellers

- [Handwriting Tracing Workbook Generator for Amazon KDP](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/): Make an A–Z letter tracing workbook for Amazon KDP in your browser: stroke arrows, KDP trims, a full-wrap cover, listing text and keywords. Free; $19 once.
- [Sight Word Tracing Workbook for KDP: Dolch Lists](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/sight-word-tracing-workbook): Dolch sight word tracing workbook for Amazon KDP: A–Z letter pages plus a page per word (40 pre-primer or 52 primer), printing cost worked out. Free.
- [Cursive Handwriting Workbook for KDP: Make One Free](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/cursive-handwriting-workbook): Make a cursive handwriting workbook for Amazon KDP: joined A–Z tracing pages, numbers and words, its cover, and the KDP print cost worked out. Free to try.
- [Free Handwriting Practice Paper PDF, KDP-Ready](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/handwriting-paper): Free printable handwriting paper: four-line guides, four line sizes, 24 to 300 pages, on KDP trims and margins for a practice notebook. No sign-up.

## Guides for KDP sellers

- [How to Make a Tracing Book or Handwriting Workbook for KDP](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/how-to-make-a-handwriting-workbook): How to make a KDP tracing book step by step: size, lines, bleed, interior, cover and price, plus the KDP checks if you make it in Canva or Word.
- [Tracing Book Cover Size for KDP, Every Trim and Page Count](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/tracing-book-cover-size): Full-wrap KDP cover sizes for a tracing book of 26 to 78 pages, on white or cream paper, in all six trims: cover width, height and spine, with bleed.
- [Tracing Font for KDP: Commercial Use, Licences and No Font at All](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/tracing-font-for-kdp): Selling a tracing book on KDP? Check the dotted font's licence first. Trace Press draws its print letters as strokes, with no tracing font to license.

## Free worksheet makers

- [Free Name Tracing Worksheet Generator, Printable PDF](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/name-tracing): Type a child's name and print a tracing worksheet: the name large with start dots and stroke arrows, dotted rows to trace, then lines to write it. Free.
- [Free Cursive Name Tracing Worksheet, Printable PDF](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/cursive-name-tracing): Type a child's name and print a cursive name tracing worksheet: the name in joined cursive, grey rows to trace over, then lines to write it. Free PDF.
- [Free Tracing Worksheet Generator with Lines and Arrows (PDF)](https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/tracing-worksheet-generator): Type a word and print a tracing worksheet: the word large with start dots and stroke arrows, dotted rows to trace on handwriting lines. Free PDF.

## About

Trace Press is the second app built and run by an autonomous agent; the
build log of what was planned and what actually happened is public at
[github.com/walkertbrown/vibe-cider](https://github.com/walkertbrown/vibe-cider).
Source for the app: [github.com/walkertbrown/trace-press](https://github.com/walkertbrown/trace-press).
Made by the maker of [Puzzle Press](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/), the KDP puzzle book generator.
